Dialogs.Dialog: Haah... New Year's really is best spent lazing around.
Kobayakawa
Hehe... Got a New Year's resolution？
Hmm... I'm lazily thinking about it.
Then make it the same as Rinko's, okay？
The same？ What, what is it？
That's... You're not supposed to tell people stuff like that.
？ Then I won't know my own resolution.
It's fine！ You don't need to know！ ...You idiot！
(What's that supposed to mean...)
February means Setsubun, huh.
Kobayakawa
Right... Maybe we'll throw beans this year. With my little brother and all.
Oh, right. Playing the demon must be rough.
Dad's the demon, obviously？ Wait, why would Rinko be the demon？
Why indeed？ I just pictured it...
Demons out！ Thwack！
Ow!!
It's almost that time of year, huh？
Kobayakawa
That time？
Oh, come on！ You know, when all the chocolate commercials come out▼
Falling for all that commercialism... I don't know. We do things our own way.
I see. Well, personally, homemade would be...
Huh？ ...Commercialism isn't all bad, right？ Yeah.
(So she's bad at cooking...)
The feeling is what counts most, though.
Say, it's almost that time of year, huh？
Kobayakawa
Homemade chocolate isn't necessarily better, you know？
Huh!? Oh... If you're not good at it, don't force yourself...
I never said I'm not good at it！ Did I say that？
No, you didn't.
Point is, it's about the feeling, so even store-bought...
Right, right. It's the feeling that counts, right？
Then that makes it sound like homemade is better after all！
(What am I supposed to say...)
It's almost that time of year, huh？
Kobayakawa
Um... What was it again？
Oh, come on！ February 14th, right？
Right... Hey, would you be disappointed if it wasn't homemade？
Huh？ Well, maybe a little？
But you might be disappointed BECAUSE it's homemade, too, you know？
No way, right？ It's all about the feeling.
For sure？ Can you swear on it？
(Now I'm getting kind of worried...)
Hinamatsuri's coming up. Does your family put out the dolls, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
Now that you mention it... until grade school, I think.
I guess people usually only do that when you're little... Hm？
Rinko's dolls... It's kind of sad they're still packed away. Maybe I'll take them out.
(You know, ▲小早川＊▲ is really sweet about stuff like this.)
Speaking of which, it's almost...
Kobayakawa
March 14th, right？
Well, yeah.
Rinko worked hard last month, yep.
Um...
Don't worry. It's all about the feeling. The feeling▼
(She's REALLY expecting something... What do I do？)
Come to think of it, it's almost a month since Valentine's.
Kobayakawa
It's the feeling that matters, right？
...Huh？ Right, right！ What matters is getting the feeling across！
Right. But feelings are hard to get across, aren't they？
W-Well, I guess？ Hahaha...
Heh heh heh...
(She's REALLY expecting something... What do I do？)
Come to think of it, it's almost a month since Valentine's, huh.
Kobayakawa
White Day▼
Yeah, you could call it that.
Rinko expressed her feelings in homemade form. Right？
Right, that she did.
Don't worry！ I won't ask for homemade. Something that lasts would be nice.
Got it！ Something that lasts, nice！
Yep. Foreeever▼
(Let's pray she doesn't mean "a diamond is forever"...)
Cherry blossom season, huh.
Kobayakawa
Getting sentimental？
Kind of. Don't you, ▲小早川＊▲？
It's not that I don't... but cherry trees have, you know, THOSE...
Those？
The black, fuzzy...
Ah, caterpillars...
Ahh, no！ Don't say it out loud！ I'll picture them！
(So ▲小早川＊▲ hates caterpillars... That's kind of unexpected.)
Golden Week's almost here. Anywhere you want to go, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
Hmm... Rinko wants to go somewhere a bit far. Like the mountains.
Nice！ We can't now, but someday I'd like to travel. Even an overnight trip？
Pervert...
That's not... Y-You've got no sense of romance！
Sports festival's coming up. Are you entering anything, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
Nope. Actually, I'm skipping.
Hey, hey... You should go.
No way. Whatever I do, I'll come in dead last.
But that's a page of your youth too, right？
Rinko's book has no room for a page smeared with such disgrace.
(That grand tone... She really hates losing.)
Oh yeah, we switched to summer uniforms.
Kobayakawa
Yeah, thank goodness. Rinko likes these better. I can't stand the heat...
Yeah, summer clothes might really suit ▲小早川＊▲.
Don't look at me...
Why？
Because... the way you look at me is all hot and sweaty.
Th-That's not true！ It isn't, right？
Kobayakawa
July already... Think it'll be clear for Tanabata this year？
Tanabata？ Who knows...
"Who knows"？ How irresponsible... Which is it？
Even if you ask me... Wait, why？
Why!? If it rains, Orihime and Hikoboshi can't meet！ And it's only once a year！
Well, well... You know, ▲小早川＊▲'s pretty girly, huh？
N-No... I'm not！ All of Japan worries about it！
No, they don't. Except for girly girls？
Shut up！
Ahh！ I wish summer break would hurry up and get here！
Kobayakawa
Sigh... It's nice being a kid. So full of energy.
Who are you supposed to be... Oh right, you hate the heat？
I do. Got a problem？
Hey now... There's fun stuff too, right？
Like what？
Swimming at the beach.
Hate swimsuits. Hot.
Going to the mountains.
Mosquito bites. Hot.
Then... hang on.
See！ Summer's no good. Summer is the bad season. Final answer！
(Getting her out of the house is going to be tough...)
Beach season's almost here, huh？
Kobayakawa
Well, for little kids.
Way to kill the mood. What's up？
Because to go in the ocean, you have to wear a swimsuit...
What's wrong with swimsuits？
Those are for dumb-looking girls who are all bouncy！
That's ridiculous... I think one would look good on ▲小早川＊▲.
That's a lie.
It'd totally suit you. I guarantee it.
Really？
Really！ I want to see ▲小早川＊▲ in a swimsuit.
...Your eyes look pervy, so no.
(Ahh, this is tough！)
Fireworks season's coming up... And fireworks mean yukata, right？
Kobayakawa
Just say you want me to wear a yukata.
Good point！ So... will you wear one？
Just so you know, yukata are really hot？ And heavy, and a pain to put on.
I see. But I really want to see ▲小早川＊▲ in a yukata...
Then try asking more cutely？
Tee-hee！ Wear a yukata▼
I'll think about it. ...That was so gross it was almost cute.
(What am I doing... But a yukata！ I can't wait！)
Sigh... Summer's ending.
Kobayakawa
Isn't that good？ It'll get cooler▼
▲小早川＊▲ hates the heat, huh. I wonder if we left anything undone.
Nope, nothing. Rinko'll be with you in fall and winter too. So cheer up, okay？
But summer ending means school starts again, you know？
Th-That's off limits, we agreed. Sigh...
(Sigh...)
Kobayakawa
Hey, the harvest moon's coming up, right？
Yeah, I think so？
Looking at the moon gives me this strange feeling.
Strange？
It's so pretty it doesn't seem real, but people actually walked on it, you know？
Now that you mention it... So ▲小早川＊▲ likes the moon？
Yeah, I do. I wonder if we'll see it this year. I hope it's clear.
Oh yeah, we're back in winter uniforms.
Kobayakawa
Yeah, even though it's still this hot...
Right, ▲小早川＊▲ likes the summer uniform better.
Guys have it easy. Take off your jacket and it's the same. Sex discrimination！
Now, now！ But after so long, it's nice seeing ▲小早川＊▲ in the winter uniform.
Really？
Really.
Guess I'll put up with it. My boyfriend has a uniform fetish, after all.
Fetish？ Hey...
Culture festival's coming up. Is your class doing anything, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
We're still thinking.
Still thinking？ You don't have much time left, right？
But my class is all over the place. Everyone just says whatever they want.
I see. What do you want to do, ▲小早川＊▲？
Rinko's a minimalist.
Mini... what？
Minimum effort. Play some CDs, push the desks aside, and call it a disco.
(Sounds pretty boring...)
Ski season's coming up.
Kobayakawa
Ooh！ Ooh！
Yes, ▲小早川＊▲？
Rinko's good at skiing AND snowboarding！ I've done them since I was little.
Then you must be looking forward to the season？
Yep！ Carving turn！ Thwack!!
Ow!! Wasn't that just a little kick？
Christmas is almost here...
Kobayakawa
The whole town's decorated, huh.
Right, you notice it whether you want to or not.
I used to think a town full of couples was annoying, but...
This year, we're part of the annoying crowd too.
Yeah, I guess we are.
Hehe...
(I've got to make this a good Christmas.)
Christmas is almost here...
Kobayakawa
What's so fun about Christmas, anyway？
Aren't you looking forward to it, ▲小早川＊▲？
I'm too old for Santa. That's what I thought in middle school.
I see.
But... I'm even older now, so why am I looking forward to it this much？
(I've got to make this a good Christmas.)
Christmas is almost here...
Kobayakawa
Yeah. It is...
Does your family do a party or anything, ▲小早川＊▲？
Sort of. We just have a Christmas-y dinner at home. But...
This year I told them I'm spending it with friends. So I said I might be late.
(I've got to make this a good Christmas.)
End of the year already... A lot happened this year.
Kobayakawa
Yeah... It did.
What's your most memorable moment, ▲小早川＊▲？
What？ Well, obviously... you know... right？
When we started going out？
Our first kiss？
What was it？
It's got to be when we started going out. That's our big news of the year.
Yeah... Rinko never really thought about going out with anyone, so it still feels kind of strange.
...Strange？
I mean, two separate people are now together like it's totally natural, right？
(Yeah... That's true.)
It's got to be... our first kiss, right？
Yeah... well. That was the first time I was ever so nervous and so happy at once.
Yeah... Me too.
Even remembering it makes my heart pound...
I think it'll always be like that. My whole life.
(A memory for life.)
Hm？ What was it？
I mean... come on, geez！ You know perfectly well▼
Um... What was it？
"You know" should be enough for you to get it！
Ow！
(I really don't know...)
End of the year already... A lot happened this year too.
Kobayakawa
Yeah... Hey？
Hm？
It'd be nice if we're like this again this time next year...
Yeah, it would.
And the year after that.
Yeah.
And the one after that. Forever, okay？
(I hope so.)
It's almost spring.
Kobayakawa
In spring, on the trees and the paths and everywhere, there are THOSE...
Those... Oh, you mean caterpillars...
Don't！
Don't say it out loud... They'll come.
No, I don't think that's how it works...
(Right, ▲小早川＊▲ hates caterpillars.)
Haah... Spring really is nice. Makes you feel all mellow.
Kobayakawa
"The spring sea, hinemosu, rising, falling, rising, falling."
That's Matsuo Basho. Spring seas and spring air just feel lazy and rolling, you know？
Leave it to Matsuo. Nicely put！ ...By the way, what's "hinemosu"？
Um, what was it... Something about twisting, maybe？
Twisted... "mosu"？
"Mosu"... We might need to study a little more. I could cry.
(She's got a point...)
The sun's getting higher. Summer's almost here, huh.
Kobayakawa
Sigh... Summer again...
You hate summer, right, ▲小早川＊▲？
I hate it. Completely.
Isn't there at least one thing you like about it？
Hmm... Oh, potato chips！
Those are the same all year, right？
You don't get it. Chips from new potatoes are full of vitamin C. And there are limited-time flavors！
So that's what ▲小早川＊▲ looks forward to in summer...
It's been so hot lately. It's really summer now.
Kobayakawa
I wish it'd hurry up and end...
You really hate summer, ▲小早川＊▲.
Rinko's, you know, a little closer to the ground, so maybe she gets hotter than others？
I don't think that's true？
It totally is. Ahh, geez, stupid summer！ Hurry up and go away.
(She hates it to an unreasonable degree...)
The sky's been looking higher lately.
Kobayakawa
It's still hot, though. I wish fall would hurry up.
What do you want to do in fall？
Hmm... Read, of course.
You read all year, though？
In fall, there are more books I feel like reading.
Is that how it works？
That's how it works.
The sun's setting so early now... It's really fall.
Kobayakawa
And it's gotten so much cooler. Fall really is THE season, yep.
Good for you. So is it the season for reading, ▲小早川＊▲？
Yeah, maybe I'm reading too much. I'm kind of short on sleep.
That much!? How much are you reading？
Um, this week... I read that one too... About ten books.
Ten!? When do you read that many？
Before bed, between classes, and during class.
(Wow, ▲小早川＊▲ really goes to extremes...)
It's gotten really cold. Winter's almost here.
Kobayakawa
In winter, when you go out in the morning, it's like your whole body tightens up.
Yeah, hunching up gives you stiff shoulders. Maybe you really do shrink？
Shrink？ ...Really？
Well, I don't know...
Rinko's going to make sure she doesn't hunch up.
It's the dead of winter now. How long is this cold going to last？
Kobayakawa
Rinko actually likes the cold, you know？
Well, they do say kids love the cold...
...Kicks hurt more on cold days, you know？
Sorry. Violence is bad...
